title: Hollowtide Evolution Forge v5
description: Grow approved Hollowtide creatures into distinct Stage II and III forms at the game's scale, then make true rear views and eight-view sheets from their approved fronts. Updated by Claude 2026-10-14; the original Evolution Forge is unchanged.

expected_output.description: One Hollowtide creature image on flat magenta.

parts.text: Paste one Stage II or III brief from docs/creatures/creature-roster-draft.md. Begin with VIEW: FRONT to grow a new stage, VIEW: BACK for the approved form's rear view, or VIEW: EIGHT for its eight-view sheet.
For VIEW: FRONT, upload the approved front of the stage just before. For VIEW: BACK, leave empty unless the brief labels this input POSE GUIDE. Leave empty for VIEW: EIGHT.
For VIEW: BACK and VIEW: EIGHT, upload the approved front of this exact stage. Leave empty for VIEW: FRONT.
Optional: the approved Tallowroot (assets/sprites/arena/tallowroot/se.png) or the line's own approved stage, for pixel craft only. Never Preostmar.
